# ClassOverridesFieldOfSuperClass

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="info" text="off by default" />

Group: [Architecture](/rules/#architecture) · PhpStorm name: `ClassOverridesFieldOfSuperClassInspection`

Re-declaring a property that an ancestor already declares is usually
accidental: for protected/public properties it merely duplicates the
declaration (often with a diverging default), and for an ancestor's private
property it creates a second, unrelated property with the same name.

## Example

Default options:

```php{19,20,21,22,23}
<?php
trait Tracks { private $trail; }

class Model {
    use Tracks;
    private $secret;
    protected $table;
    protected $visible;
    public $id;
    protected static $registry;
    const KIND = 'model';
}
class Record extends Model {
    protected $dirty;
}

/** @property string $virtual */
class Invoice extends Record {
    protected $table = 'invoices';
    protected $dirty;
    public $id;
    public $secret;
    private $trail;

    public $visible;
    protected static $registry;
    const KIND = 'invoice';
}

class InvoiceTest extends Record {
    protected $table;
}

class Entity { protected $uuid; }
class Order extends Entity {
    /** @Column(type="guid") */
    protected $uuid;
}

class Locked {
    protected $state;
    final protected function __construct($seed = 1) {}
}
class Door extends Locked {
    protected $state;
}
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 19: Property &#39;table&#39; is already declared in \Model; drop this re-declaration.</li>
<li>line 20: Property &#39;dirty&#39; is already declared in \Record; drop this re-declaration.</li>
<li>line 21: Property &#39;id&#39; is already declared in \Model; drop this re-declaration.</li>
<li>line 22: \Model already has a private property with this name; consider a different name.</li>
<li>line 23: \Tracks already has a private property with this name; consider a different name.</li>
</ul>

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REPORT_PRIVATE_REDEFINITION` | bool | true | Also report re-declarations of an ancestor's (or ancestor trait's) private property (D5). |

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "ClassOverridesFieldOfSuperClass": {
      "enabled": true,
      "options": {
        "REPORT_PRIVATE_REDEFINITION": true
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore ClassOverridesFieldOfSuperClass

/**
 * @noinspection ClassOverridesFieldOfSuperClassInspection
 */
```
